verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It uses unique normalized barycentric coordinates to derive the directed side-ratio identities, proves necessity by multiplying the coordinate ratios at the concurrency point, and proves sufficiency by explicitly constructing a point with positive barycentric coordinates lying on all three cevians. The nondegeneracy and interiority hypotheses are used appropriately, and there are no external references, hard-prohibition violations, critical errors, or gaps.
